question: Yamini Krishnamurthy is a famous exponent of which form of dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy is a renowned Indian classical dancer who is known for her expertise in Bharatanatyam.**
 
• Bharatanatyam is a classical dance form that originated in the state **of Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• It is characterized by** intricate footwork, hand gestures, facial expressions**, and body movements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi** is another classical dance form that originated in the eastern state of **Odisha, India**.

 
 
• It is characterized by fluid movements, graceful poses, and expressions that depict mythological stories.
 
 
 
• **Bihu** is a folk dance form that originated in the state** of Assam, India.**
 
 
• It is performed during the festival of Bihu and is characterized by energetic movements and lively music.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniattam **is a classical dance form that originated in the state **of Kerala, India.**
 
 
• It is characterized by subtle movements, graceful expressions, and** storytelling** through dance.
